name: Cast the Horoscope (Assamite Sorcery: Whispers of the Heavens)

system.description:
Path: Whispers of the Heavens, Level Three. (Note: the original power name at this level was lost to damage in the surviving source text; this title is a reconstruction of its function.) A diviner who knows a subject's name and date of birth (or date of Embrace, for Cainites) can trace the stars under which he was born to learn diverse facts about his history and destiny — his best trade, his personality, or the reward that awaits him.

System: The player wins a Static Mental Challenge (one-Trait penalty if only the name or birth date is known, three-Trait penalty if neither is known). Each success reveals one piece of information about the subject's core identity; five successes hint at his ultimate fate. A botch alerts the subject that someone has been watching him, and he will recognize the sorcerer as his watcher if they ever meet.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Assamite Sorcery: Whispers of the Heavens)
